## `neuro.promise.catch`

Instance method on `Promise.prototype`.

> Attaches a callback for only the rejection of the Promise.

## Signatures

```ts
catch(input: { promise: <receiver>; onrejected?: (reason: any) => TResult | PromiseLike<TResult>; prompt?: string }): Promise<Promise<T | TResult>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Promise.prototype.catch` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
